name: Upstash
shortDescription: Serverless data platform offering Redis, Kafka, queues, and vector storage.
description: Pay-per-request, serverless data platform offering Redis, Kafka, QStash (HTTP-based queues), and vector storage with global latency optimization.
We adopt Upstash for event streams, caching, queues, and lightweight vector/RAG needs in serverless and edge environments with minimal cold start overhead.
category: Serverless Data Services (Redis, Kafka, QStash, Vector)
useCases: Serverless Redis caching and rate limiting
QStash background jobs and event pipelines
